title: How Saying Sorry First Makes a Godly Man Safe to Follow
caption:
Nobody follows the man who is never wrong. They follow the man who goes first, even into the apology.

Christ went first into the cost. A man who belongs to Him can say sorry without flinching.

Save this for the next time you owe someone a hard sentence.

#faith #godlyman #leadership #humility
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
